newsitem.title: UK: AA begins work on O'Hare cargo hub expansio.
newsitem.headline: AA begins work on O'Hare cargo hub expansio.

text.p: American Airlines Cargo has begun work on a $2.8 million expansion plan, to add 7,800 sq.foot to the cargo facility at Chicago's O'Hare International Airport, the airline said in a statement relreased here

Once completed, the hub will include four new doors with handling equipment, that will let four additional trucks be unloaded at the same time using a by-pass system designed for handling loaded containers.
Expansion of the cargo facility will be completed by October 1 1997, in time for the busy holiday season the airline said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
